Pasadena Police Department — Policy 620.

§ 620.1 Policy.
This policy is reviewed and any changes are made in consultation with the Community Police Oversight Commission and the Independent Police Auditor.

§ 620.8 Reports.
An ANNUAL REPORT shall be provided to the Chief of Police, the Independent Police Auditor, the Public Safety Committee and/or the City Council, and the Community Police Oversight Commission, including the number of times the cellular site simulator technology was used.
